claim: The Bybit naked sweep never checks that the journal row's direction matches the exchange position side before using that row's SL/TP to repair it, so a phantom opposite-direction row (the very row the same pass flags as journal_qty_divergent) can supply the stop level for the top-up leg or Full-mode re-arm.
evidence: Loop iterates all open rows keyed only by (account, symbol); `sl = row['stop_loss']` ... `_bybit_top_up_partial_sl(acc, symbol, row, uncovered, a_sl)` with no `row direction == exch_side` guard. Repro R3 (one-way XRPUSDT, venue Buy 10 with a 4-qty SL leg; journal: phantom short id=1 SL 110/TP 80, long id=2 SL 90/TP 130): top-up called with [(1, 'short', 6.0, 110.0)] and summary {'broker_naked': 1, 'partially_naked': 1, 'topped_up': 1, 'journal_qty_divergent': 1}.
expected: Only rows on the exchange position's side (or on the matching hedge book) are eligible to supply protective levels; opposite-side rows are skipped for repair.
actual: Row order (rowid, no ORDER BY) decides; the phantom short's SL 110 is placed as a Partial SL on a long whose own SL is 90. The venue refuses it only when mark <= 110; when mark > 110 a stop at an arbitrary other trade's level is placed (INFERRED from Bybit's SL-below-price rule; not exercised against the venue). The Full-mode fallback with an inverted bracket is always refused by the venue, then the next row is tried.
population: Bybit symbols carrying an open opposite-direction phantom row (journal_qty_divergent > 0) while partially covered.
fix: Skip rows whose _norm_position_side(direction) != exch_side in the repair branch (grading still per symbol); prefer the newest/most-conservative same-side row's SL.
proposed_fix: Skip rows whose _norm_position_side(direction) != exch_side in the repair branch (grading still per symbol); prefer the newest/most-conservative same-side row's SL.
detector: unit test R3 shape: top-up must use the long row's SL or refuse

The close path passes `reduce_leg=is_reduce_leg`; the local sweep excludes intent_reduce rows in SQL. clients.py docstring: without reduce_leg 'both the close-side translation and the entry_price filter point at the wrong record and strand the realised PnL as NULL'. Repro R4: lookup kwargs ['direction','entry_price','opened_at_ms','qty','symbol'], reduce_leg '<absent>' for a row with setup_type='intent_reduce'.

population: Closed intent_reduce rows with pnl NULL on broker-reader accounts, within 7 days of close.
fix: Forward reduce_leg=_is_reduce (compute it before the lookup) — or decide explicitly that reduce legs stay deferred and exclude them from the query like the local sweep.
proposed_fix: Forward reduce_leg=_is_reduce (compute it before the lookup) — or decide explicitly that reduce legs stay deferred and exclude them from the query like the local sweep.
detector: unit test: intent_reduce row -> lookup called with reduce_leg=True

claim: _reconcile_options_expiry_and_assignment concludes a row from ANY lifecycle activity on the same underlying root within the 4-day lookback, with no check against the row's created_at or its own OCC legs, so a new structure not yet visible in option_positions is closed using a PREVIOUS structure's expiry cash.

proposed_fix: Filter activities to date >= row created_at date and to the row's recorded leg symbols; stamp closed_at from the activity; skip if the activity ids were already consumed by another row.

claim: run_exit_evaluation_tick has no per-package/per-strategy exception isolation, so one exception out of _apply_update aborts evaluation of every later strategy in the pass, and in the EXIT_LOOP_DECOUPLE_DISABLED rollback path run_monitor_tick then skips the entire reconciliation half (all naked-position sweeps).

Repro (scratchpad/repro_e2.py): strategies [A,B,C], _apply_update raising for A -> 'run_exit_evaluation_tick RAISED', packages reached ['A-1'] (B, C never evaluated); run_monitor_tick raised and reconciliation half ran: False. expected: Each package's verdict application is wrapped (error counted in the strategy summary) and the reconciliation half runs regardless of the exit half's outcome.

fix: try/except around _call_strategy_monitor+_apply_update per package (count into summary.error_count); in run_monitor_tick wrap the exit half so the reconciliation half always runs.
proposed_fix: try/except around _call_strategy_monitor+_apply_update per package (count into summary.error_count); in run_monitor_tick wrap the exit half so the reconciliation half always runs.
